args: v0 baseline: refactored into named groups, cond_mode=none (matches LEAN-v16)
evals.name: INTERP-v0-baseline

args: v1b: aggressive replication, K=round(120/d_g) cap 16. Stronger banded-ridge emulation than v1a.
evals.name: INTERP-v1b-cond

args: v2a: curated voicing-gated interactions. pitch×voicing, flux×voicing, phon×{flux,loud,voicing}, comb×voicing, etc. ~34 raw dim → 136 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2a-interact

args: v2b: v2a + band-energy log-ratios (4 bands → high/low, high/mid, mid/low, very-high/very-high, plus voiced/unvoiced sibilance, centroid×loud). ~41 raw dim → 164 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2b-interact

args: v2c: v2b + envelope×lag-1 self products (AM proxy) for 4 carriers + flatness×loud + HNR_d×ΔF0. ~47 raw dim → 188 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2c-interact

args: v2d: v2c + formant×flux + moments×voicing + F1/F2 loc × voicing. ~54 raw dim → 216 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2d-interact

args: v2e: standalone — squared zero-mean key signals (9, captures DEVIATION energy ridge cannot get) + per-band temporal AM products log_e[t]*log_e[t-3] (20) + per-band energy*onset (20). 49 raw → 196 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2e-interact

args: v2f: ultra-tight 5-product set — hnr_d×loud, (1-voicing)×flux, flat×loud, flat×flux, (hi-lo)×flux. Anti-correlated pairs only. 5 raw → 20 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2f-interact

args: v2g: v2f + 5 more curated pairs (pitch×flat, pitch×sib-ratio, formant_disp×loud, logF0×flat, hnr_d×flux). 10 raw → 40 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2g-interact

args: v2h: asymmetric (odd-order) nonlinearities — for 10 zero-mean key signals: ReLU(z), ReLU(-z), signed cube z^3. 30 raw → 120 post-delay. Tests odd-order asymmetry ridge cannot synthesize.
evals.name: INTERP-v2h-interact

args: v2j: v2g curated products + 6 causal cross-lag products (k=2≈67ms, phonetic boundary scale): flux[t-2]*hnr_d[t], hnr_d[t-2]*flux[t], flux[t-2]*loud[t], strength[t]*f0_d1[t+2], loud[t]*flux[t+2], hnr_peak[t]*(1-hnr_peak)[t+2]. 16 raw → 64 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2j-interact

args: v2i: v2g curated products + v2h asymmetric (odd-order) nonlinearities. 40 raw → 160 post-delay. Tests whether asymmetric + product features combine additively.
evals.name: INTERP-v2i-interact

args: v2k: per-band asymmetric (odd-order) nonlinearities on z-scored long log_e — 20 bands × {ReLU(z), ReLU(-z), z^3} = 60 raw → 240 post-delay. Tests per-band odd nonlinearity for vowel/fricative distinction.
evals.name: INTERP-v2k-interact

args: v2l: v2g products (10) + v2j cross-lag (6) + v2k per-band odd (60). 76 raw → 304 post-delay. Full curated nonlinear kit.
evals.name: INTERP-v2l-interact

args: v2m: v2h asymmetric (30) + v2j cross-lag (6). 36 raw → 144 post-delay. Tests additive composition of asymmetric + cross-lag, both at 0.0764 individually.
evals.name: INTERP-v2m-interact

args: v2n: v2g products (10) + v2h asymmetric (30) + v2j cross-lag (6). 46 raw → 184 post-delay. Tests full composition vs v2m=0.0766 best.
evals.name: INTERP-v2n-interact

args: v2o: v2h asymmetric (30) + multi-scale cross-lag k=2,4,8 (=67/133/267ms): 6 pair types × 3 lags = 18. 48 raw → 192 post-delay. Tests multi-scale temporal products.
evals.name: INTERP-v2o-interact

args: v2p: v2m + asymmetric on formant 1-D (f1_loc, f2_loc, f1_amp, f2_amp): 4 sigs × {ReLU+, ReLU-, z^3} = 12. 48 raw → 192 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2p-interact

args: v2q: v2m + asymmetric on broader pool (rolloff[0..1], moment skew/kurt, comod[0..5]) = 18 v2m + 6 lag + 24 new = 48 raw asym + 6 lag → 60 raw → 240 post-delay
evals.name: INTERP-v2q-interact

args: v2r: v2m (30 asym + 6 lag) + 12 PAIRWISE PRODUCTS of asymmetric ReLU components (co-salience: ReLU(flux+)×ReLU(loud+), unvoiced×flux, etc). 48 raw → 192 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2r-interact

args: v2s: v2m (30 asym + 6 lag) + 10 TRIPLE PRODUCTS (voiced-loud-attack, unvoiced-loud-burst, voiced-sibilance × loud × voicing, etc). 46 raw → 184 post-delay. Tests depth-3 interactions ridge cannot synthesize from pairwise products.
evals.name: INTERP-v2s-interact

args: v2t: v2m (30 asym + 6 lag) + 12 RECTIFIED-TEMPORAL products (ReLU±[t-2]×ReLU±[t]): sustained/onset/offset/quiet states. 48 raw → 192 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2t-interact

args: v2u: MULTI-SCALE asymmetric. 6 key sigs (loud,strength,logF0,flux,voicing,flat) × 3 taus (4.5/15/60) × {ReLU+,ReLU-,cube} = 54 raw asym + 6 v2j lag → 60 → 240 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2u-interact

args: v2v: v2m (30 asym raw) + v2u (54 multi-scale dev asym) + 6 v2j lag = 90 raw → 360 post-delay. Tests additive composition of raw + dev asymmetric.
evals.name: INTERP-v2v-interact

args: v2w: v2v extended — all 10 key sigs × 3 taus × 3 asym = 90 + 30 v2m raw asym + 6 v2j lag = 126 raw → 504 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2w-interact

args: v2x: v2w + tau=150 (prosodic 5s scale). 10 key × 4 taus × 3 asym = 120 + 30 v2m + 6 v2j = 156 raw → 624 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2x-interact

args: v2y: v2w + multi-scale asym on 5 phonetic templates (sib,vow,nas,plo,fric × 3 taus × 3 asym = 45 new). 171 raw → 684 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2y-interact

args: v2z: v2y + multi-scale asym on 4 formant signals (f1_loc,f2_loc,f1_amp,f2_amp × 3 taus × 3 asym = 36). 207 raw → 828 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2z-interact

args: v2aa: v2z + multi-scale asym on 10 more scalars (4 moments, 2 rolloff, flux_pos/neg, hnr_d, f0_d1) × 3 taus × 3 asym = 90. 297 raw → 1188 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2aa-interact

args: v2bb: v2z + multi-scale asym on 3 band ratios (sib=hi-lo, hf=hi-mid, mid=mid-lo) × 3 taus × 3 asym = 27. 234 raw → 936 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2bb-interact

args: v2cc: v2z + LOOK-AHEAD asymmetric (10 sigs × 2 lags × 3 asym = 60). 267 raw → 1068 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2cc-interact

args: v2dd: v2z + per-band syllabic-scale (tau=15) dev z-scored asym (20 bands × 3 asym = 60). 267 raw → 1068 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2dd-interact

args: v2ee: v2z + RBF tuning curves: 10 sigs × 5 centers (-2,-1,0,1,2) = 50 new. 257 raw → 1028 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2ee-interact

args: v2ff: v2z + BAND-PASS asym (lpf_lo - lpf_hi at 3 BPs: phonetic 4.5-15, syllabic 15-60, prosodic 60-150). 10 sigs × 3 BPs × 3 asym = 90. 297 raw → 1188 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2ff-interact

args: v2hh: v2z + multi-lag temporal derivatives asym (10 sigs × 3 lags k=1,3,6 × 3 asym = 90). 297 raw → 1188 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2hh-interact

args: v2ii: v2z + 6 cross-products of dev-z at same tau (loud×flux, loud×voicing, strength×flux, flux×voicing, loud×flat, flux×flat) × 3 taus = 18 new. 225 raw → 900 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2ii-interact

args: v2jj: v2z + 6 syllabic-scale dev-level cross-lag products (tau=15 dev of flux/hnr_d/loud/strength/voicing/f0_d1, k=2 lag). 213 raw → 852 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2jj-interact

args: v2kk: v2z + v2j cross-lag REPLICATED at SYLLABIC lag k=4 (~133ms). 6 pairs × 2 lags (k=2,4) = 12 cross-lag. 213 raw → 852 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2kk-interact

args: v2ll: v2z + per-band PHONETIC scale (tau=4.5) dev asym across 20 cochleagram bands × 3 asym = 60 new. 267 raw → 1068 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-final3

args: v2ll: v2z + per-band PHONETIC scale (tau=4.5) dev asym across 20 cochleagram bands × 3 asym = 60 new. 267 raw → 1068 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2ll-interact

args: v2mm: v2z + prosodic-tau (150~5s) dev asym on 10 key sigs (10×1×3=30 new). 237 raw → 948 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2mm-interact

args: v2nn: v2z + ACCELERATION (2nd-derivative) asym on 10 key sigs (10×3=30 new). 237 raw → 948 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2nn-interact

args: v2oo: v2z + 20 phon×formant curated products (5 phon × 4 formant). 227 raw → 908 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2oo-interact

args: v2pp: v2z minus cube term — pure ReLU+/ReLU- asym. 138 raw → 552 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2pp-interact

args: v2qq: v2z + per-band RAW (not dev) z-scored asym on log_e_long (20×3=60 new). 267 raw → 1068 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2qq-interact

args: v2rr: v2z with finer taus (3, 9, 30) instead of (4.5, 15, 60). Same 207 raw → 828 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v2rr-interact

args: v2zz: v2xx + PHON × FORMANT curated products × asym (5 phon × 4 formant = 20 products × 3 asym = 60 new). 327 raw → 1308 post-delay. Tests phon-class-gated formant dynamics.
evals.name: INTERP-v2zz-interact

args: v3a: v2zz + KEY-SIG × FORMANT curated products × asym (4 key sigs × 4 formants = 16 × 3 asym = 48 new). 343 raw → 1372 post-delay. Formant dynamics gated by voicing/loud/strength/flux.
evals.name: INTERP-v3a-interact

args: v3b: v2zz + MULTI-SCALE cross-lag (k=2,4,8) replacing single-lag v2j. 339 raw → 1356 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v3b-interact

args: v3c: v2zz + PHON × PHON pairwise dev asym at syllabic tau (10 pairs × 3 asym = 30 new). 337 raw → 1348 post-delay. Phonetic co-activation / competition.
evals.name: INTERP-v3c-interact

args: v3d: v2zz + ONSET-GATED / OFFSET-GATED phon products. 5 phon × 2 gates × 3 asym = 30 new. 337 raw → 1348 post-delay. Phonetic onsets/offsets.
evals.name: INTERP-v3d-interact

args: v3e: v2zz + v3a key×formant (48) + v3d onset/offset phon (30). 405 raw → 1620 post-delay. Composition test.
evals.name: INTERP-v3e-interact

args: v3f: v3e but onset/offset gates at 3 taus (4.5/15/60). 5 phon × 2 gates × 3 taus × 3 asym = 90 new. 435 raw → 1740 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v3f-interact

args: v3g: v3e but KEY × FORMANT products expanded to multi-tau dev asym (3 taus). 501 raw → 2004 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v3g-interact

args: v3h: v3e + 3 band-ratio dev asym at syllabic tau (9 new). 414 raw → 1656 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v3h-interact

args: v3i: v3e + HNR-onset/HNR-offset gated phon × asym (5 phon × 2 gates × 3 asym = 30 new). 435 raw → 1740 post-delay. Alternative onset driver to v3d's flux-onset.
evals.name: INTERP-v3i-interact

args: v3j: v3e + voicing-gated band-ratio multi-tau asym. 4 ratios (hi-lo, hi-mid_lo, mid_hi-lo, hi-mid_hi) × 2 voicing states × 3 taus (4.5/15/60) × 3 asym = 72 new. 477 raw → 1908 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v3j-interact

args: v3k: v3e + formant velocity × phon × asym. 4 formant Δ (Δf1_loc, Δf2_loc, Δ(f1+f2)_amp, Δ(f2-f1)) × 5 phon × 3 asym = 60 new. Captures vowel-specific formant transitions. 465 raw → 1860 post-delay.
evals.name: INTERP-v3k-interact

args: v3l: v3e + 6 named CLASS-SPECIFIC curated single-products (HNR_d×phon_vow, sib-ratio×phon_fric, flux×phon_plo, strength×phon_nas, f12_disp×phon_vow×voicing, logF0×phon_vow×voicing). 411 raw → 1644 post-delay. Small (6 raw, 24 post-delay) targeted addition.
evals.name: INTERP-v3l-interact
